newsitem.title: USA: Abiomed to sell 1.2 mln shrs to Genzyme.
newsitem.headline: Abiomed to sell 1.2 mln shrs to Genzyme.

text.p: Abiomed Inc said on Thursday its board authorized the sale of 1,153,846 common shares to Genzyme Corp's Genzyme General division at $13 per share, for a total of $15 million.
The deal would leave Genzyme holding about 14 percent of Abiomed's outstanding shares, the company said in a news release.
Abiomed shares closed up 1 to 13-3/4 in Nasdaq trading on Thursday. Genzyme was up 1/4 to 26-3/4.
The companies are discussing collaborative arrangements to develop products in the "biosurgery" area, which combines biotechnology and biomedical engineering.

The Genzyme investment agreement contains a standstill arrangement preventing it from acquiring additional Abiomed voting securities. Genzyme also must vote its shares in the same proportion as those voted by other Abiomed shareholders.

Abiomed also said it authorized the sale of 90,000 shares at $13 each to certain company directors, who also were to buy another 150,000 shares from David Lederman, Abiomed's president and chief executive, at the same price.
Abiomed makes cardiovascular, medical and dental products.
